SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM eoms_repair_apply a INNER JOIN psi_unit u ON a.customer_id = u.id WHERE u.unit_code = #{customerNo} AND a.del_flag = '0' AND a.photos IS NOT NULL AND a.photos != '' AND UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM eoms_repair_order o INNER JOIN psi_unit u ON o.customer_id = u.id WHERE u.unit_code = #{customerNo} AND o.del_flag = '0' AND o.photos IS NOT NULL AND o.photos != '' AND UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM eoms_repair_record r INNER JOIN eoms_repair_order o ON r.repair_order_id = o.id INNER JOIN psi_unit u ON o.customer_id = u.id WHERE u.unit_code = #{customerNo} AND r.del_flag = '0' AND ( (r.processing_photos IS NOT NULL AND r.processing_photos != '' AND FIND_IN_SET(#{fileId}, REPLACE(r.processing_photos, ' ', '')) > 0) OR (r.completed_photos IS NOT NULL AND r.completed_photos != '' AND FIND_IN_SET(#{fileId}, REPLACE(r.completed_photos, ' ', '')) > 0) ) UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM eoms_contract c INNER JOIN psi_unit u ON c.customer_id = u.id WHERE u.unit_code = #{customerNo} AND c.del_flag = '0' AND c.file_id IS NOT NULL AND FIND_IN_SET(#{fileId}, REPLACE(c.file_id, ' ', '')) > 0 ) t

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eoms_repair_apply a WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.customer_id=#{customerId} AND a.reporter_account_id=#{accountId} AND a.del_flag='0' AND (FIND_IN_SET(#{fileId}, REPLACE(a.photos,' ','')) > 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM eoms_repair_order o WHERE o.apply_id=a.id AND o.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND o.customer_id=a.customer_id AND o.del_flag='0' AND (FIND_IN_SET(#{fileId}, REPLACE(o.photos,' ','')) > 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM eoms_repair_record r WHERE r.repair_order_id=o.id AND r.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND r.del_flag='0' AND (FIND_IN_SET(#{fileId}, REPLACE(r.processing_photos,' ','')) > 0 OR FIND_IN_SET(#{fileId}, REPLACE(r.completed_photos,' ','')) > 0)))))

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM eoms_repair_apply a JOIN psi_unit u ON u.id=a.customer_id AND u.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE u.id=#{customerId} AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 AND u.status=1 AND a.del_flag='0' AND FIND_IN_SET(#{fileId}, REPLACE(a.photos,' ','')) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM eoms_repair_order o JOIN psi_unit u ON u.id=o.customer_id AND u.tenant_id=o.tenant_id WHERE u.id=#{customerId} AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 AND u.status=1 AND o.del_flag='0' AND FIND_IN_SET(#{fileId}, REPLACE(o.photos,' ','')) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM eoms_repair_record r JOIN eoms_repair_order o ON r.repair_order_id=o.id AND r.tenant_id=o.tenant_id JOIN psi_unit u ON u.id=o.customer_id AND u.tenant_id=o.tenant_id WHERE u.id=#{customerId} AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 AND u.status=1 AND r.del_flag='0' AND o.del_flag='0' AND (FIND_IN_SET(#{fileId}, REPLACE(r.processing_photos,' ','')) > 0 OR FIND_IN_SET(#{fileId}, REPLACE(r.completed_photos,' ','')) > 0) UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM eoms_contract c JOIN psi_unit u ON u.id=c.customer_id AND u.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE u.id=#{customerId} AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 AND u.status=1 AND c.del_flag='0' AND FIND_IN_SET(#{fileId}, REPLACE(c.file_id,' ','')) > 0 ) owned_refs
